full_details: You were awake at one. The clove was on the board, and you did not get up to write. You were awake again at three, and the pillow was the whole of it. At two the plot said The Shrew, at the Theatre, and it gave you no name of a part. You did not add one. At night the letter of the last of August was still sealed on the chest. Tomorrow is the eleventh. You did not break the wax to put a tooth into it. You did not open the coffer.
one_sentence: You woke at one and at three with the left tooth, and played The Shrew.
title: Woke at one and at three
